trades.name: Back test long of 7449-7452 up to 7459
trades.quote: 7449-7452 up to 7459 is the ideal area to long a back test. The market never seems to be that kind but that is the spot. If we trade lower first (haven’t failed above today’s high) then I am more willing to look for dips higher as anything above 49-52 is fine.
trades.stop_hint: I’ll be just a bit more patient if there is some kind of bearish sequence (like a LAAF today’s high) in play.

trades.name: Reactive long in 29387-29413 single prints
trades.quote: I like the idea of getting long in the 387-413 single prints if a reactive bid shows up. This is less clean than for ES as it risks looking like a failed breakout already, but I am more willing to do so if we trade lower first without a bearish sequence (like a LAAF of today’s high) in play.

trades.name: Deeper trap long near 29317 (29317-29341)
trades.quote: I also have more willingness to get long on a deeper trap closer to the 317 area than I am for ES because of some differences in structure but I would still be more cautious as it risks being a failed breakout.
